newsitem.title: USA: Chr. Hansen BioSystems buys Pioneer Hi-Bred unit.
newsitem.headline: Chr. Hansen BioSystems buys Pioneer Hi-Bred unit.

text.p: Chr. Hansen BioSystems A/S, the parent company of Chr. Hansen BioSystems, said Friday it acquired a Probios line of animal health products from Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Chr. Hansen BioSystems is an agricultural operation of Horsholm, Denmark-based Chr. Hansen.

Probios produces animal health microbial products which includes oral gels, premixes, powders and boluses for dairy, beef, swine, poultry, horses and pets. The acquisition also includes the Probiocin product line, which includes similar microbial products marketed through veterinarians.
